@everyone CHARITY STREAM: sat nov 21, 10am to 10pm, for the linden community pantry

posting this early on purpose. last yr half the server didnt find out till the day of and we ended at $212. this yr the goal is $600 and i think we clear it

where the money goes: lindenpantry.example/mrkz
it goes straight to the pantry, nothing taken off, i never touch it. every $1 gets them about 4 pounds of food. theyre feeding around 340 families a week rn and denise from the pantry said the shelves are the lowest shes seen before thanksgiving

rook is matching the first $100 so the first hundred counts double

what u get out of it:
$100 = i play a full round w the controller upside down
$250 = chat picks my hair dye color and i do it ON STREAM
$400 = 1 hour of only chat picked songs, no skipping
$600 = i vlog a grocery pickup the pantry sets up

and yeah i know charity streams can feel like begging w extra steps. but its not begging if u get hair dye content out of it lol. u get to watch me suffer, the pantry gets food, everybody wins

even $3 helps, thats like 12 pounds of food. and if u cant give anything thats completely fine, nobodys keeping track. just come hang out

no card? u can still help:
- drop canned or boxed food in the blue bin by the pantry's side door, saturdays 9 to 1
- show up and be loud in chat
- send the stream to ppl who do have a card (parents, cousins, that one friend w a job)

the plan: first half is community lobbies, anyone can join, ill drop the code. second half chat votes on a new game every 2 hrs. no repeat maps, i promised larry

pinning this. nov 21, 10am, be there
